name: KrispCall
description: KrispCall is a cloud-based business phone system providing global calling, SMS/MMS, and voicemail in one unified inbox, with call recording, IVR, power dialer, and 100+ integrations for growing businesses.
best_for: Positioned for small and growing businesses that want an affordable cloud phone system with global numbers, unified calling/SMS/voicemail, and CRM integrations, without enterprise-grade contact-center complexity.
features: Unified inbox for calls, SMS, MMS, and voicemail in a single window
Global business phone numbers across 100+ countries
One-click call recording on web and mobile apps
Multi-level IVR, power dialer, and call transfer/routing
Customizable welcome messages, auto attendant, and hold music
100+ integrations including HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.notes: Billed at $12/user/month annually ($15/user/month billed monthly). For teams of 1-5 needing business calling, SMS, and basic call routing. Includes 1 free US/UK/CA number per user.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Billed at $32/user/month annually ($40/user/month billed monthly). For growing teams of up to 50 users; adds call recording, call transfer, transcription and summaries, Power Dialer, bulk SMS, and Salesforce integration.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: For teams of 50+ seats requiring SSO, a dedicated account manager, custom SLAs, or volume pricing. Custom quote.

pros: Confirmed low entry price ($12/user/month annual) for a full cloud business phone system, including a free number per user
Global number coverage across 100+ countries with 100+ third-party integrations
Every paid plan includes a 14-day money-back guarantee
cons: No free tier — paid subscription required from the start, unlike some competitors with a limited free plan
Calling and SMS usage is billed separately from the subscription, and numbers outside the included US/UK/Canada options can add fees

faq.question: Does KrispCall have a free plan?
faq.answer: No. KrispCall does not offer a permanent free tier; the Essential plan starts at $12/user/month billed annually. Every paid plan includes a 14-day money-back guarantee.

faq.question: How much does KrispCall cost?
faq.answer: The Essential plan starts at $12/user/month billed annually ($15/user/month billed monthly), for teams of 1-5. Standard is $32/user/month billed annually ($40 monthly), and Enterprise uses custom pricing. Calling and SMS usage is billed separately.

faq.question: What integrations does KrispCall support?
faq.answer: KrispCall integrates with 100+ applications, including CRMs like HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pipedrive.
